translations.web: They are seven kings. Five have fallen, the one is, the other has not yet come. When he comes, he must continue a little while.
translations.bsb: There are also seven kings. Five have fallen, one is, and the other has not yet come. But when he does come, he must remain for only a little while.
translations.kjv: And there are seven kings: five are fallen, and one is, and the other is not yet come; and when he cometh, he must continue a short space.
translations.asv: and they are seven kings; the five are fallen, the one is, the other is not yet come; and when he cometh, he must continue a little while.
